[[Achor's Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Achor the Bladed]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Crystal Overlook]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[Physical damage]])
